## History

Jerry Corcoran offered a political bribe to [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) near the [Lake of Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-shining-waters). [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) witnessed this transaction between the two men. To prevent Jerry's bribe from being exposed and ruining his reputation, Judson agreed to Anne's demand to remove patent medicine advertisements from his fences.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P58](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0058), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P65](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0065)_
